title.en: écosse, terres de légendes at the meg.
title.de: écosse, terres de légendes im meg.

line.en: a film screening at 18:00 at the musée d'ethnographie, part of festival celtiques, followed by a talk with joanne mciver and jean-sébastien tingaud. chf 15 adults, chf 10 children, in french.
line.de: eine filmvorführung um 18:00 im musée d'ethnographie, teil des festival celtiques, danach gespräch mit joanne mciver und jean-sébastien tingaud. chf 15 erwachsene, chf 10 kinder, auf französisch.
line.tr: saat 18:00'de etnografya müzesi'nde film gösterimi, festival celtiques'in parçası; ardından joanne mciver ve jean-sébastien tingaud ile söyleşi. yetişkin chf 15, çocuk chf 10, fransızca.

sparks.why: Screening of the film Écosse, terres de légendes at the MEG, Fri 13.11 18:00, part of Festival Celtiques, per ADEM (https://adem.ch/en/evenements/scotland-land-of-legend) and geneve.com; the festival programme says 'jeudi' but 13.11.2026 is a Friday, so the day was checked against the calendar.
